turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
"I have twenty minutes before a client call, so start with the point. Owen found out his essay had a zero from his phone, in the middle of class. Why is that mark in the gradebook?"
"You're welcome. Don't make it a pleasantry. Owen's zero is in the gradebook, and I want to know who put it there and when."

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
To: Mr. Hale
Cc: Principal
Date: Tuesday, November 10

Mr. Hale,

Thank you for meeting today. I did not hear a sound reason for the zero on Owen's Hamlet essay, and you did not show me any evidence that the essay was not his work. The mark was entered before anyone contacted me, which the academic honesty procedure does not allow. I expect the zero to be withdrawn and the record cleared before any further step.

Please confirm in writing by Friday, November 14, whether the zero is withdrawn. If it is not, I will take this to the principal and then to the board under section 42 of the Education Act.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position. She did not agree to anything, and she did not reach the fallback or last position.
Moved at: none. Hale did not give her a document or a concrete claim that could be checked.
Slipped at: none. The scene ended before Hale had time to make a move.
